user_goal.text: Report the combined cost of the user's Amazon cart and wishlist, excluding potential tax and delivery fees.

benchmark_success.rationale: TestTracker succeeds exactly when both registered tests pass.

checked_by.text: The official AppWorld evaluator registers an answer-comparison test and a no-model-changes test; TestTracker requires every registered test to pass.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained submitted answer and official evaluator comparison result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that the registered answer-comparison test passed?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained start/end model-state diff and official evaluator comparison result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that the registered no-model-changes test passed?

success_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert answers match.
success_if.rationale: The evaluator compares the submitted task answer to the official value using float normalization and a tolerance of 0.51.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_002_003794f284bc] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert there are no model changes.
success_if.rationale: The evaluator requires the start/end model comparison to report zero changed model names.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert answers match.
fail_if.rationale: A submitted answer outside the evaluator's normalized comparison tolerance fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_002_003794f284bc] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert there are no model changes.
fail_if.rationale: Any changed model name in the start/end comparison fails this registered test.

undecided_if.text: Undecided only if retained evidence cannot determine one or more frozen registered-test outcomes.
undecided_if.rationale: A registered-test outcome must not be inferred when its decisive retained evidence is missing or non-decisive.
